notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
notes.notes:
Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
Hello. This is the Slayer: The Demon Haunted World development team.

In this update, we focused on adjusting elements related to mid-boss progression, projectile pattern correction, weapon visibility improvement, and stage event enhancements. These changes aim to improve combat flow and overall usability.
[hr][/hr]Update Details
Improved mid-boss re-entry path
Once players enter a mid-boss battle and clear it once, the entrance key will now respawn closer to the boss area for subsequent attempts.
Additionally, teleport points or shortcuts will now appear to reduce unnecessary travel time on retries.

1st Chapter mid-boss projectile skill pattern fix
We have corrected an issue where the projectile skill used by the first mid-boss in Chapter 1 would fly off at irregular angles.
It now fires at consistent angles, allowing players to more clearly anticipate and respond to attacks.

Player weapon size increased
The size of player-held weapons has been increased across the board.
This improves visual clarity of attack range and makes directional targeting easier to read during combat.

3-6 stage switch interaction camera update
In Chapter 3, Stage 6, a camera movement (Timeline) sequence has been added to show the position of the floor created through switch interaction.
This helps players clearly understand what was triggered and where the newly generated platform appears.
[hr][/hr]
We are always working to make Slayer a more refined and strategically engaging action experience.
Your feedback continues to guide us, and we remain committed to bringing you ongoing improvements and new content.

Thank you.
— Slayer: The Demon Haunted World Dev Team

notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Details
notes.notes:
Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Details
Hello,
This is the development team of Slayer: The Demon Haunted World.

In this update, we focused on enhancing immersion through additional dialogue in the tutorial and world map, introduced two new items related to falling hazards, and rebalanced projectile DOT (damage-over-time) mechanics.

Though this is a relatively small-scale patch, we consider it a meaningful step toward expanding what makes Slayer unique — offering strategic, high-tension gameplay experiences.
[hr][/hr]Patch Notes
1. Added dialogue to the tutorial and world map

A new line of dialogue has been added to the guard at the end of the tutorial, offering a short in-universe guide before players move forward.

Additional guard NPCs at the sea gates on the world map now feature dialogue as well, adding atmosphere and narrative context to exploration.

2. New Item: Wings of Salvation

To reduce the frustration caused by instant game-overs from falls, we’ve added the “Wings of Salvation” item.

If the player possesses this item, it automatically activates upon falling to restore them to their last position before the fall.

3. New Item: Graven Sole

We’ve also added “Graven Sole,” which prevents all falls in the stage where it is used.

This item is particularly useful in maps with high verticality and will enable more strategic planning and survivability.

4. Projectile DOT Damage Adjustment

We fixed an issue where projectile-based damage-over-time effects were applying lower-than-intended damage.

These values have now been corrected, and DOT-based skills and weapons will be more effective as a result.
[hr][/hr]Looking Ahead
We continue to monitor gameplay feedback and data closely in our ongoing effort to improve the combat feel and overall immersion of Slayer.

The highly anticipated Fallen Mode is actively in development.
It will introduce a fully restructured map, new enemies, expanded story branches, and high-difficulty content worthy of a major update.

We are also preparing improvements to controls, new boss patterns, and expanded skill tree systems — all of which we’ll share more about in the near future.
[hr][/hr]
We extend our deepest thanks to everyone who continues to play and support Slayer.
Your feedback and encouragement are what drive us forward.
We are committed to making Slayer deeper, more polished, and more rewarding with every update.

Thank you,
— The Slayer: The Demon Haunted World Dev Team

notes.title: Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
notes.notes:
Slayer: The Demon Haunted World – Update Notice
Hello, players.
Slayer: The Demon Haunted World is evolving constantly.
Our development team is working hard every day to improve the experience for all of you who enjoy the game.
In this update, we’ve applied various fixes and improvements based on your valuable feedback.
Here are the full patch details:
[hr][/hr]UI and Convenience Improvements
Added X Button to Mode Selection Panel
We have added a close (X) button to the mode selection UI on the main menu, improving user convenience and intuitive control.

Fixed Overlapping Level-Up UI Elements
When leveling up for the first time, the character status panel, level-up tutorial message, and damage numbers no longer overlap visually.

Stat Tutorial Box Behavior Adjusted
The guidance box in the stat tutorial now disappears automatically after assigning stat points, eliminating confusion for new players.

Improved Inventory Gold Visibility
Adjusted font size and color of the gold display in the inventory UI to make it more legible.
[hr][/hr]Combat and Game System Improvements
Parry Tutorial Level Redesigned
To help players focus better on learning the parry system, we have redesigned the level layout.
The tutorial monster’s HP is now removed, and when the player tries to attack, a parry guide message appears to encourage proper response.

Extended Parry Window
We slightly increased the parry timing window for enemy attacks, lowering the difficulty of parrying and improving accessibility for newer players.

Torch Interactions Improved
You can now deal at least minimal damage to all objects using the torch.
For objects that do not respond to fire-based damage-over-time effects, a message prompts players to switch to a weapon.

Enhanced Critical Hit Visuals
Critical hit effects have been upgraded with more vivid particles to emphasize impact and visual flair.
[hr][/hr]Terminology and Visual Updates
Mode Name Changes
We renamed the game modes for better clarity:

“Casual” is now “Action”

“Standard” is now “Master”

“Hell Mode” is now “Hardcore”
This change helps better reflect the intent and challenge level of each mode.

World Map Visibility Extended
The world map view range has been expanded, making navigation and direction-finding easier.

Treasure Chest Rewards Guaranteed
We removed the chance of treasure chests giving no rewards.
You will now always receive at least gold when opening a chest.
[hr][/hr]Scenario and Visual Presentation Updates
Fade-out Effect When Skipping Opening Scene
Skipping the opening scenario now includes a fade-out transition for smoother presentation.
[hr][/hr]
Our team is deeply grateful to everyone who has supported Slayer.
We are fully committed to delivering a game that is not only stylish and strategic, but also continuously improving based on community feedback.

If you’ve joined the Slayer journey already, thank you.
If not, now is the perfect time.

We are building this world every day—for your enjoyment.
See you in the tower.

— The Slayer Development Team

notes.title: 🛠️ [Major Update Notice] – New Game Modes & System Improvements!
notes.notes:
🛠️ \[Major Update Notice] – New Game Modes & System Improvements!
Hello, this is the Slayer: The Demon-Haunted World development team!

We’re excited to bring you one of our biggest updates yet — introducing new game modes, exciting system upgrades, and gameplay improvements based on your valuable feedback. Whether you enjoy strategic combat, fast-paced action, or roguelike challenges, there's something new for everyone!
[hr][/hr]🎮 New Game Modes Added!
🧠 Standard Mode (formerly "Tactical")

This is the core Slayer experience — a strategic action RPG that emphasizes precise movement, timing, and unique parry mechanics. Use your surroundings and stamina wisely to overcome intense challenges.

⚔️ Casual Mode – Stylish & Fast!

For players who love faster, freer combat, Casual Mode allows you to attack in all directions without restrictions. No need to worry about strict movement — enjoy the thrill of fast-paced action!

🔥 Hell Mode – Roguelike Challenge!

Hardcore adventurers, this is for you! In Hell Mode, you only get a limited number of lives. Lose them all, and it's back to the beginning.
Each run is a test of skill, and we’ll be adding time records in future updates to track your ultimate Slayer journey!
[hr][/hr]🧱 Update Highlights
🛡️ Increased the drop rate of shields from chests.

🚶‍♀️ Added an Eliya animation beneath the loading bar that shows her moving toward the next stage.

🌳 Wooden floor tiles now show different colors based on how close they are to breaking.

🔥 Brazier buffs now last 60 seconds, giving you more time to benefit from their power.

🆕 Added Casual Mode and Hell Mode to the game.

🧭 Casual Mode enables freedom of movement and rotation in all four directions for stylish and explosive gameplay.

☠️ In Hell Mode, battle with limited lives — once they're gone, you must start from the beginning!
[hr][/hr]
We’re constantly refining Slayer to give you a better, deeper experience — whether you’re here for the strategy or the spectacle.

Try out the new modes and tell us what you think!
Thank you for your continued support. More great content is coming soon!

— Slayer Dev Team

🛠️ [Hotfix Notice] – March 26, 2025

Hello, this is the Slayer: The Demon Haunted World development team.
Thank you to everyone enjoying the game!

This hotfix includes several bug fixes, quality improvements, and balance adjustments.
Please check the details below — and we always welcome your feedback to make the game even better.

✅ Fixes & Improvements
Fixed a bug where the parry tutorial could be cleared instantly

Added floor object to indicate the key spawn area in Chapter 4

Added missing fall-death zone in Chapter 5

Increased the defense buff value from the brazier

Removed duplicate key item in Chapter 9

Projectiles from monsters can now be parried

Disabled in-inventory use of "Elixir of Life" and improved its description

Added stun effect to the skills: Diamond Blade Technique and Storm Impact

Fixed bug where equipment icon didn't update when unequipped via right-click

Removed obstructing box in Chapter 8 path

Adjusted balance of several monsters

Thank you as always!
– The Slayer Dev Team

notes.title: [Hotfix Notice] – March 24, 2025
notes.notes:
🛠️ [Hotfix Notice] – March 24, 2025

Hello everyone, this is the Slayer: The Demon Haunted World development team.
First of all, thank you so much for playing our game!

Thanks to your support and feedback, we’re continuing to improve and refine the experience.
This hotfix includes the following updates:

✅ Fixes & Improvements
Fixed incorrect translation of the "Truth / Lie" sign

Fixed a bug where some gimmicks that shouldn't deal damage were still harming the player

Adjusted monster positions that were blocking player paths

Reduced projectile speed and movement speed of the Chapter 2 boss

Fixed rare issue where death animation didn’t play

Added delay to the first attack of ranged wizard-type monsters

Fixed rotating gimmick in sy_ch1_lv4 that overlapped with the player

Fixed gimmicks that were incorrectly stunning the player

🎮 We’re committed to making the game even better.
Your feedback and encouragement mean the world to us.
Thank you again, and enjoy the hunt!

– The Slayer Dev Team

notes.title: 🛠️ [Hotfix Notice] - March 21, 2025
notes.notes:
🛠️ [Hotfix Notice] - March 21, 2025

Hi everyone, this is the dev team of Slayer: The Demon Haunted World.
We’ve applied a hotfix to address a few issues found right after launch.

✅ Fixes
Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when opening the inventory in certain stages. (Previously only resolved by opening the skill window)
Locked FPS to 120 to better suit the game's mechanics.
💬 Dev Note
We tested a lot before release, but bugs that only appear on launch day are always a mystery...
Thanks so much for playing even through unexpected issues.
We’ll keep improving the game!
